title: `sufr create` parses `--seed-mask` after clap instead of through it
body:
`CreateArgs::seed_mask` in `sufr/src/lib.rs` is an `Option<String>`, and `create` turns it into a `SeedMask` with `parse()` after clap has parsed the arguments. A bad mask is reported as an `anyhow` error from inside `create`.

## Proposal

Since ff48244, `SeedMask` implements `FromStr` with `anyhow::Error` as its error, so the field could be `Option<SeedMask>`. clap would then reject a bad mask during argument parsing, with its own usage message and exit code 2.

## Open

- Whether clap's `value_parser!` accepts `anyhow::Error` as the `FromStr` error has not been checked by building it.
- No test in `sufr/tests/cli.rs` pins the current message for a bad mask, so nothing there would break, but the exit code and message change for users.
close_reason: Landed in 4595984 on branch `worktree-seed-mask-fromstr`, which replaces 5b90b69 on dev. clap accepts `anyhow::Error` as the `FromStr` error. A bad mask now fails during argument parsing, before the input is read, with "invalid value '1021' for '--seed-mask <MASK>'" and exit code 2; it was "Invalid seed mask" and exit 1 after reading the input. The CHANGELOG lists it under Changed. No test pins the message or exit code.
